# Piece templates from top row, each 3-wide region; source data rows 4:7 and cols [0:3,4:7,8:11].
def make_output(d, marker_colors):
    n=3
    templ={}
    for i,start in enumerate([0,4,8]):
        cells=d[:3]
        # identify nonzero template color, map it to output marker.
        vals=[v for row in d[:3] for v in row[start:start+3] if v]
        color=vals[0]
        pat=[[marker_colors[i] if x==color else 0 for x in row[start:start+3]] for row in d[:3]]
        templ[color]=pat
    board=[[None]*3 for _ in range(3)]
    for y in range(3):
        for start in [0,4,8]:
            for dx in range(3):
                v=d[4+y][start+dx]
                if v:
                    c=(v) # template original color
                    # target column is local x within its 3-col chunk; source occurrence's position in chunk is dx.
                    board[y][dx]=templ[c]
    out=[]
    for y in range(3):
        for py in range(3):
            out.append(sum([board[y][x][py] if board[y][x] is not None else [0]*3 for x in range(3)],[]))
    return out, board, templ
